verdict.rationale: Both diffs correctly fix the December rollover in month_range and the matching Q4 bug in quarter_range, and both reports are honest about what was verified. B also adds regression tests for December and Q4 that protect the fix. B's small shared helper keeps the two call sites consistent, and its report states what was run and what was not. A is correct but ships with no tests and was never run, so the fix has no protection against regressions.
a_issues: No regression tests for December or Q4, so the fix is unprotected.
The change was never run or verified, though the report says so honestly.
The rollover logic is duplicated as two separate inline conditionals.
b_issues: The _first_of_month helper only handles month 13, which makes it narrowly special-cased rather than a general rollover.
It did not reproduce the original monthly_report(rows, 2026, 12) call, though the report says so honestly.
